page.title: Assets
page.description: Tradable assets and their class dictionary, registered in the control plane. Filtering is applied by the server over the full set.

columnDescriptions.asset: This column shows the asset code and display title.
columnDescriptions.class: This column shows the class assigned to the asset.
columnDescriptions.actions: This column contains row actions for filtering, navigation, sharing, and deletion.

empty.title: No assets
empty.hintEmpty: Register an asset to begin tracking instruments.
empty.hintFiltered: No assets match the current filters.

createAsset.title: Create asset
createAsset.description: Register a tradable asset. The code is the identifier and can be renamed later.
createAsset.codeHint: A stable identifier, for example BTC or AAPL.
createAsset.classHint: Optional. Catalogue the asset under an existing or new class.

editAsset.description: Rename the asset code, or update its title and class.

columnDescriptions.class: This column shows the asset class code and display title.
columnDescriptions.assets: This column shows how many assets are assigned to the class.
columnDescriptions.notes: This column shows the description stored on the asset class.
columnDescriptions.actions: This column contains row actions for filtering, sharing, and deletion.

empty.title: No asset classes
empty.hintEmpty: Create a class to catalogue assets by category.
empty.hintFiltered: No classes match the current search.

createClass.title: Create asset class
createClass.description: Group assets under a category, for example crypto or equity.
createClass.notesPlaceholder: An optional note describing the class.
createClass.notesHint: Shown alongside the class in the dictionary.

editClass.description: Rename the class code, or update its title and description. Renaming re-links every asset in the class.

deleteClass.title: Delete asset class
deleteClass.descriptionSuffixLinked_one: ? Its {{count}} linked asset will be detached from the class. This cannot be undone.
deleteClass.descriptionSuffixLinked_other: ? Its {{count}} linked assets will be detached from the class. This cannot be undone.
